summary_1line: After parting from Krishna, the Pandavas reach the Payosini River where Lomasa recounts ancient kings’ grand sacrifices and the sacred merit of the site.

image_candidates.scene_text: At the Payosini River, shining golden sacrificial stakes prepared for a king’s rites are raised while gods led by Indra look on.
King Gaya’s vast sacrifice spreads across the earth with countless golden utensils, priests gathered from all directions receiving immense gifts.
Yudhishthira and his brothers arrive at the quiet banks of the Payosini, greeted by gathered Brahmins praising the exiled king.
